nina: Yep. Will add meta descs and FAQ schema. Thoughts on 4 Qs: pricing, latency, private deploy, integrations.

leo: Ill check all internal links on hub and ensure anchor diversity. Also will flag any orphan pages.

sam: Redirects: retire /benchmarks-old -> /webinar/benchmarks-2026. Use 301. Also canonicalize any tracking variants.

seo-bot: Quick pre-publish scan: 1 missing meta description on /webinar/benchmarks-2026, 2 images missing alt. Link health ok.

sam: Nina pls drop PR by EOD. Leo pls do a final pass after PR.

nina: Will do.

sam: Done. Thanks.
